resources.string: ShieldLink checks links with VirusTotal. Use your own free VirusTotal key so the checks run on your account. Gambling-site blocking works without a key.
Create a free VirusTotal account (or sign in), then open the API key page and copy the key. It is 64 letters and numbers.
The key is checked once with VirusTotal, then stored encrypted on this phone. It is never shown in full again.
Clipboard is empty. Copy your key first.
That does not look like a VirusTotal key (64 letters and numbers).
Key saved. VirusTotal says the free limit (4 requests per minute) is used up right now, so wait a minute before testing.
VirusTotal rejected this key. Copy it again from your API key page.
Could not reach VirusTotal. Check your connection and try again.
Key removed. Link checks fall back to the gambling list only.
Try a link before you rely on it. The harmless EICAR test file is flagged on purpose by antivirus engines: https://secure.eicar.org/eicar.com
Test failed. Check the key and your connection.
